requirements.statement: A merchant can sign up for a merchant account

criteria.must: A new merchant can sign in and access the merchant portal
A merchant can start accepting payments immediately after signing up, with no approval step

requirements.statement: A merchant can create a payment request with an amount, currency and description

criteria.must: A merchant can submit an amount, currency and description to create a payment request
A created payment request starts in pending status

requirements.statement: Each payment request comes with a shareable link a merchant can send over SMS or email

criteria.must: A created payment request has a shareable link
A merchant can trigger sending the link to a customer via SMS or email

requirements.statement: A merchant can see the status of each payment request

criteria.must: A payment request shows one of pending, paid, failed or expired
A payment request's status updates once a customer completes or fails payment

requirements.statement: A merchant has a dashboard/history of all their payment requests and transactions

criteria.must: A merchant can view a list of all their payment requests
A merchant can view a list of all their transactions

requirements.statement: A merchant can configure the bank account collected funds should settle to

criteria.must: A merchant can enter and save bank account details for payouts

requirements.statement: A merchant can see their current balance and payout history

criteria.must: A merchant can view their current available balance
A merchant can view a history of past payouts

requirements.statement: A merchant can trigger a payout of their available balance to their bank account

criteria.must: A merchant can trigger a payout of their available balance
Payouts are never scheduled automatically without the merchant triggering them

requirements.statement: A merchant can refund a completed payment

criteria.must: A merchant can issue a refund for a completed transaction

requirements.statement: A customer can open a payment link and see the amount, currency and merchant name before paying

criteria.must: Opening a payment link shows the amount, currency and merchant name without requiring sign-in

requirements.statement: A customer can pay a merchant's request using mobile money or a card

criteria.must: A customer can complete payment via mobile money
A customer can complete payment via card
A customer pays without creating an account

requirements.statement: A customer receives a confirmation by SMS or email once their payment succeeds

criteria.must: A successful payment triggers a confirmation sent to the customer by SMS or email

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can see every merchant and their transaction activity

criteria.must: A platform admin can view a list of every merchant on the platform
A platform admin can view transaction activity across all merchants
